notes: Network limits: cmc.telangana.gov.in, ghmc.gov.in, legislature.telangana.gov.in member pages, hmda.gov.in ORR pages, ceotelangana.nic.in RWA/polling lists and most sansad.in member pages could not be fetched. Gaps follow from this, not from absence of data.

Boundaries were determined from locality names against statutory mandal-level AC extents (AP Reorganisation Act 2014, Sch. XXVII) - not from polygon boundary files. Points near AC/district lines are left null.

Since 11 Feb 2026 the points inside the ORR fall under the Cyberabad Municipal Corporation (CMC), not GHMC; zone/circle placements rely on press reports of CMC's ward list, so 'ward' is null everywhere.
Police commissionerate assignments rely on press; a 1 Oct 2026 redraw of 76 police stations was reported without a station list.
No official source states who maintains any NH65 stretch here; road_owner is null for S01, S04, S06, S13, S19.
City-road owners are inferred (CMC) and marked confirmed=false.
MLA party affiliations deliberately omitted (several elected on BRS tickets later associated with Congress; Speaker dismissed disqualification petitions in Dec 2025).
No RTI PIO (L5) contact was obtained for any owning office.
Districts reflect the current mandal-district mapping; any 2026 district reorganisation was not checked.

S01.local_body: Cyberabad Municipal Corporation - Serilingampally zone (Patancheruvu circle per press)

road_owner.note: NH65. No official page found stating which agency maintains this stretch. Press reports NHAI executing NH65 widening between Patancheru and Sangareddy (https://telanganatoday.com/nh-65-traffic-diversion-between-patancheru-and-sangareddy-from-september-26); PIB 5 Mar 2024 records foundation for six-laning of a 29 km Pune-Hyderabad section of NH-65 near Patancheru without naming the agency (https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleseDetailm.aspx?PRID=2011518&reg=48&lang=2).
